lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A release is a GitHub Release with `vitadeck.vpk` attached plus the matching `@vitadeck/sdk` and `@vitadeck/host-companion` on npm, all cut from one tag. The two packages share one version because the SDK scaffold (`create --host-plugin`) depends on the companion at its own version. Releases stay manual: [`release.yml`](../.github/workflows/release.yml) never creates tags.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. Open a PR that bumps `version` in [`js/packages/sdk/package.json`](../js/packages/sdk/package.json) and [`js/packages/host-companion/package.json`](../js/packages/host-companion/package.json) to the same value, then merge it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. Tag the merge commit on `main` with the same bare version and push the tag:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The workflow fails before building anything if the tag differs from either package version. Otherwise it builds the VPK (version `XX.YY` from the tag, patch dropped), publishes the companion and then the SDK with npm provenance, skipping a version already on npm so a failed run can be re-run, and creates the release with notes generated from the merged PR titles. While the major version is 0, the release is marked as a pre-release.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: npm authenticates the workflow with Trusted Publishing (OIDC), so the repo has no `NPM_TOKEN` secret. Each package needs a Trusted Publisher with owner `matemolnar8`, repository `vitadeck`, workflow filename `release.yml`, allowed to run `npm publish` (not only `npm stage publish`): on npmjs.com, open the package → Settings → Trusted Publisher → GitHub Actions, or run `npm trust github <package> --file release.yml --repo matemolnar8/vitadeck --allow-publish` (npm 11.15 or later, 2FA required).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A Trusted Publisher needs the package to exist, so for a new package `npm trust github` first publishes a `0.0.0-stage` placeholder; nothing is published by hand. `latest` points at that placeholder until the first release. A new Trusted Publisher must publish within 2 days, so add it shortly before pushing the tag.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Try the packages before they are on npm

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: To test the SDK and the companion the way an author gets them, pack both and install the tarballs into a throwaway prefix. A scaffold's own dependencies name the npm version, so point them at the tarballs too:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: cd "$D" && vitadeck create my-app --host-plugin && cd my-app
